about: Stand measurements the choice constants were fitted on (scratchpad fit_choice.py, 2026-10-23): decode tokens a second per stream at `context` tokens with `concurrency` rows, prefill tokens a second (null: not measured). Short-chat rows are C-stream aggregates over C at a 512-token context. A row marked "step" is the step itself: the decode of C concurrent requests apart from their prompts.
